# The SME war score as a slider, -100 to +170, in the decision category
# wif_sme_war_category. The bar is one of 55 pictures, one per 5 points
# (interface/wif_sme_war.gfx), picked by the scripted localisation
# wif_sme_war_bar_sprite - all generated by tools/gen_sme_collapse.py and
# tools/gen_sme_collapse_assets.py.
scripted_gui = {
	wif_sme_war_ui = {
		context_type = decision_category
		window_name = "wif_sme_war_ui_window"

		properties = {
			wif_sme_war_bar = {
				image = "[wif_sme_war_bar_sprite]"
			}
		}
	}
}
